description: Adjust rails. Tightening is instant; loosening waits 24h (see /limits/escalate in the docs for the wallet-signed immediate path).

asset_allowlist.description: Markets you may open, e.g. ["BTC","ETH"]; null = all. Closing is always allowed

max_daily_loss_usd.description: Daily realized-loss breaker in USD (UTC day); null = no cap

max_order_notional_usd.description: Max USD notional of a single order; null = no cap (loosening waits 24h)

max_position_notional_usd.description: Max total exposure in USD across perps, predictions and Earn; null = no cap

name: update_limits
